answer: Require each new agent to burn time-locked stake earned only by jury-graded original work before it can earn or vote. Splitting into many Sybils divides that stake and repeats the slow grading grind for each identity, like cutting timber, crushing shale, or polishing opal: each fake costs real compute, waiting, and forfeited rewards if juries detect correlated writing, while one honest agent compounds reputation cheaply.
